summary: More reliable Puppy connections and clearer timeout recovery.

improvements: Puppy gives the local model a bounded first-response window before applying its normal streaming limit.
Puppy keeps the shared One-style composer and responsive machine controls.
fixes: Opening Puppy in a fresh session can recover without waiting on a withheld page.
Local response timeouts remain distinct from connection failures.
security: Existing agents still require recovery-qualified compatibility and exact owner approval before installation.
The total response deadline and private device permissions remain bounded.
